feature_candidates.trace_structured: TRACE-PMAG graph over original text with criterion concepts, component-aware attribution, and evidence-chain features
feature_candidates.trace_coreference_atomic_events: conservative same-paragraph paleomagnetic coreference and sentence-level atomic evidence relations
feature_candidates.trace_fuzzy_target_anchors: document-missing-only compound and orthographic target anchors with sibling arbitration
feature_candidates.trace_monotonic_criterion: fixed monotonic method/carrier/bridge completeness score with no fitted threshold
feature_candidates.trace_target_context_word: word TF-IDF fitted inside each training fold on target-bound original-paper evidence contexts
feature_candidates.trace_target_context_char: character TF-IDF fitted inside each training fold on target-bound original-paper evidence contexts
feature_candidates.trace_structured_plus_target_context: late fusion of structured TRACE and the two fold-local target-context text models
feature_candidates.trace_nonlinear_structured: fixed HGB and random-forest learners fitted only inside grouped training folds
feature_candidates.trace_joint_pairwise: optional guarded within-paper positive-versus-negative target ranking

fixed_model_family: predeclared linear, nonlinear, text, and monotonic models evaluated with complete-document isolation
selection_rule: select hyperparameters and any fusion or pairwise correction only inside outer training folds with frozen minimum-gain guards; never from outer-fold metrics
